# pantechdynamics_kubernetes_addon (Resource)

Turns a managed add-on of a pantechdynamics_kubernetes_cluster on or off: metrics-server (the cluster's own metrics-server, for kubectl top and the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler), csi-driver (persistent volumes on the node's own disk, StorageClass local-path; the data stays on that node) or ingress-controller (ingress-nginx, the default IngressClass, served on 80 and 443 of the cluster's public address in a VPC zone). A cluster starts with metrics-server and csi-driver on, and the platform keeps the choice applied. Create and update wait until the cluster runs (or has stopped running) the add-on. Destroying the resource turns the add-on off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The platform installs the add-on and keeps it applied; status shows what
# the cluster runs.

# CPU and memory metrics, for kubectl top and the autoscalers. Destroying the
# resource turns the add-on off.
resource "pantechdynamics_kubernetes_addon" "metrics" {
  cluster_id = pantechdynamics_kubernetes_cluster.prod.id
  name       = "metrics-server" # or csi-driver, ingress-controller
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Id of the cluster, starting with k8s_. It must be running. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) The add-on: "metrics-server", "csi-driver" or "ingress-controller". Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the add-on is on. Defaults to true. Changes in place.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "<cluster_id>/<name>".
- `status` (String) What the cluster runs of the add-on: "active", "installing", "removing", "disabled", or "unavailable" (the cluster has no such component).
- `version` (String) The add-on's version, once the platform reports one.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An add-on is imported as "<cluster_id>/<name>".
terraform import pantechdynamics_kubernetes_addon.metrics k8s_06ggex1abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw/metrics-server
```
